verdict.rationale: Audio and video calls are a fair axis for a team chat product like Zulip. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions starting calls, video meetings, or call integrations from a channel or DM. The pack covers only topics, channels, search, bots, integrations, export and self-hosting.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can start an audio or video call directly from a channel or DM without leaving the app
